free_tier_limits.correction: MIT-licensed self-hosting is free, and the project now provides an official hosted live demo requiring no installation; the demo is limited to 2 requests/second per IP and a 5 MB request body.

rate_limits.correction: Self-hosted deployments have no project-wide request rate limit, but the official hosted demo publishes limits of 2 requests/second per IP and a 5 MB request body.

notes: The localhost URL is the documented deployment-local default, so HTTP 0 without a running container is expected. The API remains active and has an official hosted demo. Although auth.type is correctly none by default, the details are outdated: current Gotenberg offers optional built-in Basic Auth, not API-key middleware.
